notes: Checked against the About page and the footer of a current Updated Edition chapter page (Chapter 1). The About page says the project is formally operated under CC BY-SA 4.0 and invites use, distribution and modification; the About page's own timeline is the 2013-2015 text, but the current chapter pages, published in partnership with Stanford University Press, carry "CC BY-SA 4.0" in their footer, so the licence covers the current edition. CC BY-SA allows commercial use, so a paid app may show chapter text with the credit in attribution, and what Ceder changes stays under CC BY-SA 4.0. Figures carry their own, varied credits and are link only (see parts); quoted primary sources inside chapters need their own check. No terms-of-use page was found on the site. Only Chapter 1 was read; other chapters were assumed to carry the same footer. The Primary Source Reader, the first-edition archive and the Stanford print and PDF editions weren't read and aren't covered by this entry. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
